events.verdict: Dudley (BKN) establishes himself in a screening position and absorbs the contact from Galloway (DET).
Allen (BKN) establishes himself in a screening position from a wide stance, but he does not deliver any leg-to-leg contact to Smith (DET).
Drummond (DET) blocks the shot attempt prior to the ball making contact with the backboard.
Smith (DET) makes contact with Allen's (BKN) arm that affects his ability to control the rebound.
Drummond (DET) makes marginal contact with Harris (BKN) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Griffin (DET) establishes himself in a screening position and makes marginal contact with LeVert (BKN).
Dudley (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position during Jackson's (DET) driving shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) sets the pick on Smith (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Smith (DET) is trailing and makes body contact with Dinwiddie (BKN) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Griffin (DET) sets the screen on LeVert (BKN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
LeVert (BKN) makes marginal contact with Jackson (DET) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) firms up in a legal position and sets the pick on Jackson (DET).
Drummond (DET) makes marginal contact with Allen (BKN) that does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Smith (DET) is in a screening position firming up in Dudley's (BKN) path and he absorbs the contact.

LLB shows that LeVert (BKN) makes contact with Griffin's (DET) wrist during his upward shooting motion that causes him to lose control of the ball. LeVert never makes contact with the ball before it goes OOB and it is incorrectly awarded to the Pistons.
Smith (DET) sets the screen on Harris (BKN) and the two players briefly engage.
Drummond (DET) establishes himself in a legal screening position in Dudley's (BKN) path.
LLB shows LeVert (BKN) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
RAR shows that Galloway (DET) cleanly dislodges the ball from LeVert (BKN).
The loose ball occurs within three seconds of Griffin (DET) being in the lane without actively guarding an opponent.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Dudley (BKN) possesses the ball while part of his body is out of bounds.
Griffin (DET) is established in a screening position and he firms up and absorbs the contact from Graham (BKN).
Dudley (BKN) commits a take foul on Jackson (DET).
Robinson III (DET) maintains a legal guarding position during Harris' (BKN) jump shot attempt.
